resources.string: Payees are saved when you add a transaction with a name in \"Paid to or received from\". Their category and tags are filled in next time.
New transactions for this payee get this category and these tags. You can still change them on any one transaction.

plurals.name: payees_merge_body
plurals.item: %1$d transaction moves from %2$s to %3$s. %3$s keeps its name, category and tags, and %2$s is removed.
